name: RobustStress
description: RobustStress is an English benchmark for evaluating AI-generated text detectors under gradually intensified, semantics-preserving synonym replacement and LLM-based paraphrasing. It supports domain-specific and cross-domain evaluation under model-specific and cross-model settings.
citeAs: @inproceedings{yan2026robuststress, title={RobustStress: Stress-Testing AI-Generated Text Detectors under Gradual Perturbations}, author={Yan, Youcheng and Liu, Jinshuo and Li, Qiyuan and Liu, Xinya and Gu, Jinguang and Ji, Donghong and Pan, Jeff Z.}, booktitle={NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track}, year={2026}, url={https://openreview.net/forum?id=lb5EY9x2CQ}}

rai:dataLimitations: Although our benchmark covers two widely used attack types, namely synonym substitution and paraphrasing attacks, it does not yet comprehensively examine more complex attack patterns such as prompt injection or stylistic obfuscation.
rai:dataBiases: Our tool aims to measure robustness against intensity-controlled perturbations and does not introduce additional bias in the data generation process.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: These datasets do not contain personally identifiable information (PII) or sensitive private data.
rai:dataUseCases: The primary use case of this dataset is to evaluate and improve the adversarial robustness of AI-generated text detectors.
rai:dataSocialImpact: This work contributes to the development of more reliable and trustworthy AI systems. It helps prevent malicious AI-generate text of LLMs in real-world applications.
